_note: "Buyers are looking for X" seller-recruitment cards (source: seller-growth/WANTED-POSTS.md, numbers from the [GrowthDigest] of as_of). prep adds one every WANTED_GAP_DAYS between the listing cards, skips them all once as_of is older than WANTED_MAX_AGE_DAYS, and links /sell-equipment/<slug> only when that page answers 200 (link_path overrides). RULE (Alan 2026-11-10): buyer interest only. Never say searches came up empty, buyers found nothing, or none/zero/one listed. Refresh the numbers and as_of from the newest digest; never an exact count below 10, never views or sales. Spanish lines wait for Alan or Emmanuel to proofread.

posts.card_sub: Sitting between jobs? List it free.
posts.body:
Buyers looked for generators on YardSwaps about 20 times in the last month.
If a generator is sitting in your yard between jobs or since the last storm, list it free: photo of the unit, photo of the data plate, the app fills in kW, fuel and phase. Buyers pick up at your place.
posts.question: What size is the one you have sitting?

posts.card_sub: Gooseneck, dump or utility. List it free.
posts.body:
More than 20 trailer searches on YardSwaps last month.
Gooseneck, dump, tilt or utility: if it hasn't moved since the last job, list it free. Photograph the VIN plate and the tires. Buyer hitches up at your yard.
posts.question: What's the trailer you keep meaning to sell?

posts.card_sub: Old reel in the truck? List it free.
posts.body:
Buyers searched YardSwaps for sewer and pipe inspection cameras more than 10 times last month.
Upgraded to a new camera and the old reel is in the truck? List it free and let someone else put it to work.
posts.question: What camera are you running now?

posts.card_sub: Trash, transfer or a spare motor. List it free.
posts.body:
More than 10 pump searches on YardSwaps last month.
Trash pumps, transfer pumps, spare motors on a shelf: snap the tag, list it free, buyer picks up.
posts.question: Got a spare pump that hasn't run this year?

posts.body:
About 10 searches for jetters on YardSwaps last month.
If a cart or trailer jetter got replaced and is parked out back, list it free. Put GPM, PSI and hours in the photos.
posts.question: What GPM is the one you'd sell?

posts.card_sub: Data plate, hour meter, done. List it free.
posts.body:
Buyers are searching YardSwaps for forklifts.
Moved to electric, or downsized the warehouse? Photograph the data plate and the hour meter, list it free, buyer comes to you.
posts.question: How many hours on yours?

posts.card_sub: Spare one in the shop? List it free.
posts.body:
People are searching YardSwaps for welders, some for Lincoln by name.
A spare welder or a machine from a closed shop is cash sitting on the floor. List it free, photograph the nameplate, local pickup.
posts.question: What welder is collecting dust in your shop?

posts.card_sub: Scan the tag. List it free.
posts.body:
Buyers search YardSwaps for parts every day, and some of what they need is sitting on your shelf.
Extra parts on a shelf, an attachment for a machine you sold, a unit you kept for parts: scan the tag and list it free.
posts.question: What's the one part you've got three of?

posts.card_sub: Retiring a truck? List it free.
posts.body:
Fleet trucks were the most searched category on YardSwaps last month, with more than 35 searches.
Retiring a truck from the fleet? List it free with the odometer and the door sticker in the photos. Buyer comes to your lot.
posts.question: What's the oldest truck still in your fleet?

posts.card_sub: Paste the link. Free to list.
posts.body: Already have your equipment on Craigslist? Paste the link into YardSwaps and the photos, price and details come across. Check them, publish, done. Free.
posts.question: Where do you list equipment now?
